Class Edit

java.lang.Object
UserFeatures.Edit
public class Edit extends Object
The Edit class provides the methods for transferring and editing ministry budgets. It manages a central balance for investments/transfers and includes methods for collecting input, validating data, and updating ministry budgets. Note: This class relies on the CreatingMinistries and Ministry classes for accessing ministry data and formatting budgets.

    • editingbudget

      public void editingbudget(Edit object, boolean undo, boolean isProposal)
      Edits the actual budget based on the data in the provided Edit object. It searches for the ministry and updates its budget by adding or subtracting the specified amount.
      Parameters:
      object - The Edit object containing the ministry name, change type, and amount.

    • printNewBudget

      public void printNewBudget(double finalBudget, String type, int i, boolean undo)
      Sets the new budget for the ministry and prints the result of the edit.
      Parameters:
      finalBudget - The newly calculated budget value.
      type - The type of change ("Increase" or "Decrease").
      i - The index of the ministry in the CreatingMinistries.ministries array.

    • validityCheck

      public String validityCheck(String name)
      Prompts the user for a ministry name and validates that the name exists in the list of created ministries. Repeats until a valid name is provided.
      Parameters:
      name - The initial ministry name provided by the user.
      Returns:
      The validated and existing ministry name.

    • zerobalance

      public void zerobalance(boolean isProposal)
      Handles the budget transfer process when the available balance is zero. The user must first choose a ministry to **Decrease** its budget to create available balance before any other edits can be made.

    • nonzerobalance

      public void nonzerobalance(boolean isProposal)
      Handles the budget transfer process when there is available balance. The user can choose to Increase or Decrease a ministry's budget. Increase operations consume the available balance; Decrease operations add to it.

    • validityChange

      public String validityChange(String validChange)
      Validates that the user input for the type of change is either "Increase" or "Decrease" (case-insensitive). Prompts the user to re-enter the input until a valid choice is made.
      Parameters:
      validChange - The initial user input for the change type.
      Returns:
      The validated change type string ("Increase" or "Decrease").

    • validityAnswer

      public String validityAnswer(String validAnswer)
      Validates that the user input for an answer is either "Yes" or "No" (case-insensitive). Prompts the user to re-enter the input until a valid choice is made.
      Parameters:
      validAnswer - The initial user input for the answer.
      Returns:
      The validated answer string ("Yes" or "No").

    • validityAmount

      public double validityAmount(double budgetOrBalance)
      Validates that the user-entered amount is a positive number and does not exceed the maximum available limit (either the ministry's current budget for a Decrease, or the available balance for an Increase).
      Parameters:
      budgetOrBalance - The maximum available amount (budget of ministry or available balance).
      Returns:
      The validated amount as a double.
